title: Day 3 — Refactor, Optimize & Fix
prompt: Our traffic dashboard's 'top 5 hottest endpoints' panel times out on real access logs, and tied endpoints come out in an inconsistent order. Here's the analyzer — how would you fix it?

clarifications.answer: endpointCounts re-scans the whole list for every endpoint — it's O(n^2). Target O(n) with a single-pass Map.
Tied endpoints must be broken alphabetically so the ordering is stable between refreshes.
Each log line's endpoint is the 2nd whitespace token; malformed lines (parseEndpoint returns null) are skipped.
Keep the public functions (parseEndpoint, endpointCounts, topEndpoints) identical.
Same output — top-N most-hit endpoints, highest first — just correct ordering and fast.

hints: Say out loud why the counting loop is O(n^2) and what Array.sort does without a tiebreak.
Build the count Map in one pass (counts.set(e, (counts.get(e) ?? 0) + 1)).
Add an alphabetical tiebreak to the comparator: (b[1]-a[1]) || a[0].localeCompare(b[0]).
